resources.string: Single-color interface and left-aligned messages, built into the client
Story rings, close friends and live streams
The selected shade adapts to light and dark themes. No plugin is needed. Disable the original MonoColor UI plugin before using this setting. Inspired by MonoColor UI by @limeplug.
Delivery and read marks on my messages

Messages appear on the left with sender names and avatars. Consecutive messages from the same sender stay grouped. Saved Messages and sponsored messages are unchanged. Ownership and sending behavior stay intact. Disable the original AllLeft plugin before using this setting. Inspired by AllLeft by @limeplug.

Avatars next to mentions in messages and media captions. Uses peers already known to this account; no username lookup requests or cross-account fallback. Hidden spoilers and code are excluded. Text, copying and entity offsets remain unchanged. Disable the original MentionAvatars plugin. Inspired by MentionAvatars 1.1.1 by @limeplug.
Native Player Color 1.3 by @neptuniy237. Mini and full player palette, with or without artwork. Disable the original Player Color plugin. Updates on the next player event: pause or track change.
